# Guide to Open Source in Australia

> A curated guide to Australian open source software, hardware, data, standards, research, organisations, policy and events.

Use this index to find the site's main pages. Directory entries are curated and may change; follow links on each page to check current project, organisation and event information.

## Start here

- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): An overview of the guide and its main topics.
- [Explore the directory]({{ site.url }}/explore): Browse the directory by topic, or find Australian communities and resources.
- [What is open source?]({{ site.url }}/what-is-open-source): An introductory explainer; this page is still under development.

## Other pages

- [About]({{ site.url }}/about): Why Felicity Brand created the guide and what it covers.
- [Blog]({{ site.url }}/blog): Planned writing about open source in Australia; contributions are welcome.
- [Events]({{ site.url }}/events): Australian open source conferences, meetups, hackathons and community celebration days.
- [Glossary]({{ site.url }}/glossary): Plain-language definitions of terms used across the site.
